summary: legal checked in 7 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for public exposure, rights-dependent monetization, and security-sensitive releases; conditional only for bounded reversible work preserving consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and data boundaries. Evidence: compliance is technical-only at 35 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown; analytics quality is yellow; operations and fleet-doctor sweeps have no results; all 59 security sitefacts are unknown; revenue is limited to 2026-09-21 aggregate Amazon commission of $4.92 and is not site-attributable. Exact decision: maintain containment-only execution, preserve private and parked gates, and make no unsupported financial, ROI, or causal-lift claims.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. Existing progress is evidenced by official API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts. No task closes because rights, field permissions, retention, deletion/correction/access workflows, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, rollback evidence, and owner disposition remain incomplete. Decision: keep the gated product private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle containing the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data — blocked. API documentation establishes access mechanics, but current terms do not establish rights to fetch, store, transform, cache, publicly display, retain historical derivatives, send alerts, use trademarks/images/prices, or monetize through affiliate or advertising use. Missing evidence: current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance and permitted uses, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark/image/price limits, and affiliate or advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request.

Data-use review: user alert rules and sync results — evidence_needed. The stated purpose and operational processing are understandable, but data inventory, access/session identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table, including Slack delivery and access/session identifiers.

Data-use review: GA4 analytics — evidence_needed. Measurement-only use after an explicit analytics choice is conditionally described, but deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property and data-sharing settings, retention settings, vendor disclosure, and jurisdictional treatment are not evidenced. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling new tracking, remarketing, or customer matching.

Data-use review: operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data — evidence_needed. Operational use is stated, but log fields, retention, access controls, deletion/request handling, vendor terms or DPA coverage, breach response, subpoena handling, and data-subject request procedures are not evidenced. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log-field, retention/access, vendor, incident, and request-procedure inventory and route unresolved legal gaps to human counsel.

Concrete launch decision for the parked scaffold sites: remain parked, private, and preview-only. No publish, deploy, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spend, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet covering execution ownership, preview/build evidence, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker for each site by 2026-09-30T17:00Z.
